versions.changelog:
- Removed the file: skill-card.md
- No other changes to skill logic or documentation.

- Initial release of the 网页内容抓取服务 (Web Content Fetching Service) skill.
- Allows fetching web pages and converting HTML to Markdown for easier processing.
- Strictly requires user-provided API key; prompts user if key is missing.
- Includes clear workflow: check API key, select tool, extract parameters, call API, return results.
- Main function: scripts.tools.fetch for retrieving and optionally extracting page contents.
- Enforces not to fabricate data when API key is missing; always query the user.
